# Entities

## Spatial elements

### <a id="Site"></a>Site

The piece of land the project stands on, and where it lies on Earth: the projected coordinate reference system, the base point, the grid rotation, the scale and an optional survey point (GEOREF-01, ADR 0017). A project has at most one site.

- **Introduced in:** version 2
- **IFC:** `IfcSite`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Value | Presence | Set on | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `crs_epsg` | integer | optional | instance | EPSG code of the projected coordinate reference system, such as 2154 for Lambert-93. Unset: the project is not georeferenced. |
| `base_point_eastings` | length (m) | default `0.0` | instance | Easting of the project base point, the origin of the local frame. |
| `base_point_northings` | length (m) | default `0.0` | instance | Northing of the project base point. |
| `base_point_height` | length (m) | default `0.0` | instance | Orthogonal height of the project base point. |
| `grid_rotation` | plane angle (rad) | default `0.0` | instance | Angle from the grid easting axis of the coordinate reference system to the local x-axis, counter-clockwise. |
| `scale` | real | default `1.0` | instance | Map conversion scale from local lengths to map lengths, applied to all three axes. Finite and greater than zero. |
| `survey_point_eastings` | length (m) | optional | instance | Easting of the survey point, a known point such as a benchmark. Unset: no survey point. |
| `survey_point_northings` | length (m) | optional | instance | Northing of the survey point. |
| `survey_point_height` | length (m) | optional | instance | Orthogonal height of the survey point. |
